acceptance_criteria.criterion: Record part-level reuse/repair/rebuild/unverified decisions from the comparison without selecting a source by its name or recency.

acceptance_criteria.intended_runtime: source preservation and native asset inspection
acceptance_criteria.verification: Compare pre/post source hashes and relevant native key/UV/body fingerprints.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Separate blockout execution and review from final character approval; final UV, lookdev, full rig, correctives, collision/physics and 30fps events remain incomplete.
